answers.problem: Grids need flexibility to absorb wind and solar, but buildings with controllable heating sit idle.
answers.solution: We connect building automation to reserve markets and shift heating loads automatically.
answers.traction: ARR 620k EUR, 14% month-on-month growth, 410 buildings connected in Finland and Sweden.
answers.team: CEO led energy trading at a Nordic utility; CTO built building-automation control software.
answers.whyInvest: Reserve-market prices doubled in two years and we are integrated with the largest Nordic vendors.
answers.workStyle: Engineers at heart: we test every decision with data and move fast.
